blocks.text: Ab garmi bardasht karne wala DNA polymerase, jise Taq polymerase kehte hain, dala jata hai. Chaaron qisam ke nucleotides bhi dale jate hain. Taq polymerase primer ke 3’ sire par naye nucleotides jorta jata hai. Is tarah woh DNA replication ki tarah tukre ka baqi hissa copy kar leta hai, aur poore single-stranded DNA ki complementary copy primer ke saath ban jati hai. Kyun ke dono DNA strands copy hue, is liye ab asal DNA tukre ki do copies hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “complimentary copy” likhti hai. Sahi lafz complementary hai: aisi copy jis ke bases template strand ke bases se jora banate hain (A ke saamne T, G ke saamne C). “Complimentary” ka matlab muft ya tareefi hota hai.
